401-2530-3944-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-6559.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

6528-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6528-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2438-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-6495-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-6495-6578.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6578.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

821-2173-5220-7918.description:
Cast Mogg Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3128-7824.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

338-4186-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

728-2577-6006.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1305-4460-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

628-5231-7187.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-5231-7187.notes: Once you have enough colored mana, you can remove the additional -1/-1 counter each loop from Hovel Hurler to give your other creatures infinite power.

527-1251-1409.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

643-2366-3967-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-3967-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

109-232-1235-3227.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

380-1110-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it, Terror of the Peaks and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks, dealing 4 damage to Bladewing.
Bladewing dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing token's trigger, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

270-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Hedron Archive's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
270-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

1437-2440-6276.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin has an indestructible counter on it.
You have max speed.
1437-2440-6276.description:
Cast Slick Imitator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Slick Imilator spell three times.
Resolve the first copy of the Slick Imitator spell.
When the Slick Imitator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ooze you control.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining two copies of the Slick Imitator spell.
Holding priority, activate a Slick Imitator token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying the Slick Imitator spell.
Resolve the copy of the Slick Imitator spell.
When the Slick Imitator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ooze you control.
Repeat from step 6.

428-1694-1817-3174.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
428-1694-1817-3174.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a copy of the Ghyrson Starn spell that isn't legendary.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

245-1069-3480-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-3480-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1322-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1322-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

1545-3263-4078-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1545-3263-4078-4242-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2644-3558-4763-5147.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Crookshank Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1479-2783-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1518-1964-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1964-1987-2556.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
